declaration_timing: Before root inspected v0.7 likelihood values or decoder outcomes; the Nike ambiguity audit summary is known.
primary_task: Reason over explicitly supplied prefixes of a controlled stream of frozen document versions.
primary_claim_scope: Stream-conditioned factual record interpretation and temporal update reasoning, not reconstruction of all knowledge publicly available at a historical instant.
domains: versioned public plans and explicit corrections

sampling.previously_inspected_connected_histories: development demonstrations only; not untouched evaluation

stream_manifest.order: Freeze author-defined experimental delivery batches before candidate extraction, reference judgments or decoder results. Use documented version dependencies and source chronology when known; record unresolved ordering and treat simultaneous/uncertain items as one batch. Do not silently resolve ties using answer labels.
stream_manifest.prefix: Cumulative complete delivery batches. Every method receives the same exact source IDs and bytes. No later batch, later extracted candidates or later QA labels may enter an earlier request.
stream_manifest.date_separation: Delivery index/time, retrieval time, reported publication time and event time are separate fields. Experimental delivery must never be labelled first public availability.
stream_manifest.legacy_adapter: Select the exact source-ID prefix before invoking the existing decoder. If its date-based eligibility interface is reused, use an explicitly current-record capture cutoff and record capture-based operational availability; retain a separate delivery-index manifest. Do not invent historical availability dates or overwrite asserted event/report dates.
stream_manifest.later_edits: A version retrieved now may contain later edits. Such a version can be a controlled stream input, but is not certified as its historical original. Disclose this for every affected source.

candidate_design.proposal_vs_semantic_ambiguity: Measure candidate proposal recall and precision separately from residual ambiguity after full context. A locally plausible proposal may be falsified by later eligible context; do not oracle-prune it before inference.
candidate_design.matching: Within each inference comparison freeze the same candidate union, sources, scores, null conventions, constraints and objective. Treat generator/window changes as separate experiments.
candidate_design.unsupported_fabrications: Log and evaluate unsupported candidates as extraction errors; do not manufacture them to force an exact-search advantage.
candidate_design.audit_scope: The v0.7 Nike audit measures supported residual alternatives under full supplied context only. Its zero additions do not measure general candidate recall or prove joint inference unnecessary.

evaluation.reference_target: What the supplied prefix justifies, including conflict, unknown endpoints, announced plans and explicit correction dependencies; not omniscient world truth.
evaluation.reference_process: Source-only separate annotation and recorded reconciliation, completed before method-output inspection. Model-assisted labels are disclosed and are not relabelled human gold.
evaluation.grouping: Keep connected entities and histories together when later train/development/test partitions are frozen.
evaluation.baseline: Include the strong full-prefix contextual baseline; the implemented independent decoder already optimizes links exactly conditional on its reading choices.

secondary_historical_slice.admission: Require separate evidence for historical versions and their public-availability bounds.
secondary_historical_slice.unverified_histories: Remain controlled-stream examples; never pool them into historical-replay accuracy.
secondary_historical_slice.past_public_knowledge_or_predictive_back: Forbidden without the additional historical evidence.

go_no_go: After the first twenty development histories, assess useful factual accuracy-cost gains against strong contextual and restarted baselines. Narrow the contribution if gains or meaningful coupling do not survive. Do not select a positive subset and report it as general performance.
existing_results: No v0.6/v0.7 source dates, graphs, scores, cutoffs or reported results are changed or retroactively benchmark-admitted by this design.
